The product

Some flavours of Calabria

Chilli

Chilli is the symbol of Calabrian cooking: it is used fresh, dried, ground or in oil.

Tropea red onion

It has the PGI "Cipolla Rossa di Tropea Calabria": it is sweet and is enjoyed raw too.

'Nduja and cured meats

'Nduja, a spreadable and spicy cured meat, is one of the region's best-known products.
